learningObjectives: Explain Python syntax and the basic structure of a Python program.
Create variables and use common Python data types.
Write and execute simple Python statements using operators and expressions.

activities.title: Python Program Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a simple Python program.

content.concept: Python programs are made from statements and expressions. Variables store references to values, while functions group reusable behavior.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Creates a variable named price and assigns an integer value.
Creates a variable named tax and assigns a floating-point value.
Uses variables and arithmetic operators to calculate an expression.
Calls the print function to display the calculated result.

activities.title: Data Type Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify the Python data type represented by each value.

content.concept: Common Python built-in types include int for whole numbers, float for decimal values, str for text, and bool for True or False values.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Variable Builder
activities.instruction: Assemble a valid Python variable assignment.

content.concept: Python assignment uses = to bind a variable name to a value. Variable names should follow Python naming rules and should not be reserved keywords.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Operator Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the operator that produces the required result.

content.concept: Arithmetic operators perform calculations, comparison operators produce Boolean results, and logical operators combine conditions.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
